themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, make decisions, and take actions within research environments.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Articles discussing AI tools that help developers write, debug, and refactor code, often by suggesting code snippets or entire functions.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Covers the creation and use of artificial user profiles or data for testing and research, as opposed to real human participants.

themes.name: AI research tools comparison
themes.description: Articles that directly compare the performance, features, and effectiveness of different AI tools for research purposes.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Explores how AI is changing job roles, employment opportunities, and the skills required in the modern workforce.

themes.name: AI research platform
themes.description: Features news and updates on platforms and frameworks designed to facilitate AI research and development.

themes.name: AI testing automation
themes.description: Discusses the use of AI to automate and enhance the processes of software testing, quality assurance, and validation.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Covers the application of AI directly within the design process, aiding in ideation, creation, and refinement of design outputs.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Focuses on studies and analyses of chatbot capabilities, limitations, user interactions, and potential impacts.

themes.name: AI customer insights
themes.description: Examines how AI is used to gather, analyze, and leverage customer data for better understanding and strategic decision-making.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
